Our customers have spoken! You voted, we tallied, and now it's time for the Customer Choice Awards Winners to be revealed. 

The Champs, plus Runners Up, are showcased below. Of course, all* of our tried-and-true products are always on display in your local TJ’s “Trophy Case”—aka your neighborhood Trader Joe’s store. 

Take a few minutes now to survey these Victors of Value, then stop by to pick up the ones calling your name. And while you’re at it, pick up a Prizewinner or two that you’ve yet to try. Congratulations to all! 


*Some of our winners are seasonal products. Look for them to return later this year.

Dum, dada, DUM! After reaching #2 last year, our Pork & Ginger Soup Dumplings have risen to the very top spot. Anyone who has tried them knows exactly why... savory ground Pork and bright Ginger, accented by a rich & savory broth, nestled in tender dough wrappers. Soup’s on—and in!

Our customers are pro-Pancakes, especially these fluffy flapjacks, with their delicately sweet flavor, and a whopping 20 grams of Protein per four-pack (powered by cottage cheese and egg whites). Fifteen seconds in the microwave and you’re enjoying breakfast like a pro!

We couldn’t be more excidered this beverage is headed to the Hall of Fame, having won five-plus times. This no-sugar-added sip is squeezed from U.S. apples, and brewed with seasonal spices, for ideal autumnal warmth. Watch this video to see what we’re crowing about!

Some customers assign G.O.A.T. status to our cheese case, attributing this honor, in part, to our variety of Chevre options. It's no surprise, when semi-soft Chevre adds a creamy, tantalizing tang to crackers, crudités, ciabatta, capellini... Smile and say, “Goat Cheese!”

These itty-bitty 'alligator pears' have had a gigantic impact on customers, winning the top-produce spot more than five times. Hall-of-Fame bound, our six-count, single-serving Avocados are the ideal size for slicing on a salad or smooshing on toast—no need to store the other half!

We learned a while back that one of the best ways to eat your vegetables is our Spinach & Artichoke Dip. Evidently, our customers have learned this, too! It’s a rich, Creamy mix of said veggies, plus Swiss & Parmesan cheeses, and savory herbs & spices. Lift a chip for this winning Dip!

The most important meal (#breakfast) demands something #convenient, #filling, and #delicious. Astutely, customers have recognized our shredded potato patties (#Hasbrowns) as the best, whether enjoyed alongside eggs, bacon, and toast—or as a handy, stand-alone snack. #NoGreaterTater

For lunch or later, customers say nothing's better than Butter Chicken with Basmati Rice. Our authentic Indian recipe features tender chunks of Chicken in a rich, silky, tomato-and-onion-based sauce, accented by garlic, ginger, and warm spices—ready in just ten minutes, freezer to table!

At nearly one-fifth the price of similar products in the world (and with equally impressive ingredients), our Brazil Nut Body Butter has captivated our customers' attention! It'll be back this summer; meanwhile, you might moisturize with one of our comparable Body Butters.

These crispy, crinkle-cut Chips were introduced just last April. Now, they’re top o’ the Snacks! They’re authentically Irish, (made in Ireland with Irish potatoes), and flavored with creamy, salted Butter, plus plenty of savory Garlic. With attributes like these, who needs luck?!

Our Sublimes incorporate everything one could want in a Sweet Treat: vanilla ice cream, chewy cookies, and lots (and lots!) of chocolate chips. Could this Sandwich ever win in the “Lunch & Dinner” category? It’s possible. There appear to be no limits to its sublimity!

An apple a day keeps the giraffes at play. That’s a thing, right? Well, it is at Trader Joe’s, especially when those apples are really Trader Joe’s Apple Cider Donuts, and the giraffes are really animated (and we mean animated… really). After all, what giraffe wouldn’t want to stick its neck out for a chance at one of these only-at-Trader-Joe’s cake-style donuts?

How do these donuts come to life? We visited our supplier, based in New England – where Apple Cider Donuts are an autumn tradition – to get the full story, from cider to shelf. What we found was actually surprising, because they make these donuts much the same way you’d make them at home, the same way that farm stand donuterie makes theirs, just on a (much) larger scale. How large? Watch the video and read on to find out!

blocks.title: How Are Apple Cider Donuts Made?

blocks.html:
Our supplier begins with wholesome ingredients, including a significant amount of naturally sweet apple cider, giving the donuts their rich, apple-forward flavor, making them extra moist, and contributing to their extra-fluffy texture. The dough is formed into perfect donut rings and dropped into hot oil to cook. Midway through, the rings are flipped, and the near-perfection that is a Trader Joe’s Apple Cider Donut inches ever-closer to completion.

When they’ve cooked through, they are hand-rolled in generous amounts of cinnamon-sugar, straight out of the fryer. Giving them this cinnamon-sugar treatment when the donuts are hot is imperative, and the only way to accomplish this without accidentally breaking the donuts into pieces is to do it by hand. It takes some extra time, and it requires more labor… we think it’s worth it!

We’re offering Apple Cider Donuts throughout early autumn, for as long as we can keep them in stock.

Have you seen the cereal section at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s lately? We’ve always offered a variety of tasty, bowl-worthy grains—but now, more than ever, you’ll find a wide selection of cereals that will fit almost any mood or eating occasion.

What’s your grain of choice? We have cereals made with corn, wheat, oats, ancient grains, not to mention some gluten free options. What’s your shape? We’ve got flakes, puffs, squares, Os, and even tiny little fruits. How about inclusions? Some of our cereals have berries, nuts, coconut, coffee, chocolate, and so much more!

Now we know what you’re thinking: Trader Joe’s, are you cereal right now?! Yes, we are! Sooo cereal. And we think you should be, too.

Get inspired by the handful of products highlighted here, then head to TJ’s and grab a cart-full of cereals that will become the highlight of your breakfast... or afternoon treat... or late-evening snack...

The whole-grain wheat and rice flakes in Trader Joe’s Flakes & Strawberries Cereal maintain some crunch in milk, while the freeze-dried Strawberries are quickly re-hydrated in your bowl. This dynamic textural combo is even more delightful as the lightly sweetened flavor of the Flakes interplays with the fruity, slighly tart taste of the berries. It’s a great way to kick-start your morning—or delicious way to end your day!

Trader Joe’s Organic Peanut Butter & Cocoa Crunch owes its elevated crunch factor (and gluten free status) to its corny composition, while this cereal's fantastic flavor profile comes from Organic Peanut Butter (yellow puffs) and Organic Cocoa powder (brown puffs). Experience some in a bowl with regular milk, or pair with a pour of TJ’s Chocolate Milk with Fair Trade Cocoa for a super indulgent treat!

blocks.description: Trader Joe's Tiny Fruity Cuties Cereal is made up of crescent moon and flower shapes in an array of four (natually derived) hues, and offers sweet, fruity flavor with lots of crunch. It's outstanding in a bowl with your favorite milk or non-dairy beverage, just as it is by the handful straight out of the box. These Cuties even shine crushed up in a milkshake, performing dual roles, both flavoring the shake and adorning the rim of the glass. Yes!

After two weeks of head-to-head votes, unbelievable upsets, and high-stakes hydration, the 2026 Beverage Bracket came down to two peach-powered potables: Trader Joe’s Sparkling Black Tea with Peach Juice Beverage, and Trader Joe’s Orange Peach Mango 100% Juice.

And in the end, while our Black Tea with Peach certainly Sparkled on the court, it was Orange Peach Mango’s triple threat of sweet, citric, tropicality that took the trophy home..

A twenty-year veteran of the Trader Joe’s fresh juice section, Orange Peach Mango really can do it all, whether it’s being enjoyed as an everyday quencher with breakfast, lunch, or dinner; mixed into a marvelously multi-faceted mimosa; or blended with ice to make a super sweet and satisfying slushy

Having learned of the win, Orange Peach Mango was so excited that it reportedly celebrated by dunking a cooler of itself over itself. We recommend a slightly more understated celebration: stopping by the refrigerators of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s and picking up a carton today.

Way to go, #OrangePeachMango!

blocks.html: Wine sellers tend to talk about sparkling wines during seasons of celebrations: holidays, graduations, weddings, etc. And well they should—the bubbly exudes merriment! As fate would have it, there is a fast-approaching celebration that calls for exactly such merriment—motherly merriment, to be specific. Yes, folks, we’re talking about Mother’s Day, a.k.a. the second Sunday in May. And since Mother’s Day is made for making mom figures feel mega-marvelous and extra-special, why not pop a bottle of Trader Joe’s Blanc de Blancs in honor of the matriarchy?

Our Blanc de Blancs—literally, “white of whites”—is a dry, crisp, and citrusy sparkling white wine from France made from—you guessed it—white grapes. It’s a brut sparkler, with a yeasty, flowery aroma, delicate, fruity flavors, and just the right amount of fizz. Most importantly for mom, it makes an excellent anchor for a mimosa brunch-in-bed, complementing everything from an all-you-can-eat waffle bar to more savory fare, like breakfast tacos, a basic breakfast sandwich, or a fancy frittata.

There’s just something about the sprawling, bucolic beauty of an apple orchard; it’s the kind of sight that can put a die-hard, pumpkin-spiced cynic in a festive, fall mood.

The family-owned supplier of our fully baked Trader Joe’s Apple Blossoms invited us up to their orchard, in Canada’s Niagara Fruit Belt, which just so happens to be located less than two miles from where they bake our Blossoms. Needless to say, without a moment’s hesitation, we packed up our cameras and headed to Canada!

By the time we arrived, spring blossoms had made way for an abundance of fall fruit. But while we couldn’t capture how blossoms become apples (which has some real snooze-fest potential, anyway), here’s a peek at how apples become Blossoms…

blocks.title: A Blossom A Day Keeps Fall Blues Away!

blocks.html:
Trader Joe’s Apple Blossoms have been a Customer favorite in our frozen foods section for nearly 20 years. And it’s no wonder why—they’re unbelievably delicious. Plus, they’re lovely to look at.

Picture a single-serving apple pie, only instead of resting in a regular pie crust shell, the apple filling is enveloped by six, carefully folded pie crust “petals” and sprinkled with a cinnamon oat crumble, making the pie look just like (you guessed it!) a Blossom. Or picture a palm-sized, pastry coin purses filled with sweetened & spiced Northern Spy apples instead of gold (arguably even better than gold).

Or, instead of picturing anything, press play on our video above, then head to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s to buy a box of your very own! If you’ve got a baking sheet, an oven, and 20 minutes to spare, then you’ve got a warm, dreamy dessert in your very near future...

Like all things enduring, not even the harshest chill can keep these bountiful bundles from blossoming; you’ll find them in our freezers.

blocks.html: In the nautical world, a boatswain (pronounced “BO-sun”) is the petty officer of a ship, in charge of all that happens on deck. In the world of Trader Joe’s, Boatswain is a line of beers we’ve sold for a boatload of years.

Among the Boatswain deckhands manning our shelves, Boatswain Double I.P.A. is perhaps the hardest worker and most reliably robust. Brewed exclusively for us by an award-winning craft brewer in Wisconsin, this ale is intensely hoppy with plenty of malt to balance the bitterness. Beyond its bold flavor, it also boasts a bold 8.4% alcohol by volume. You might say it’s made for the serious craft beer drinker, or the beer aficionado who’s always scanning the horizon for something interesting to imbibe. You know who you are!

Enjoy Boatswain Double I.P.A. chilled and chasing spiced dishes, like BBQ Cedar Wrapped Salmon, or our Vegan Enchilada Casserole. It’s also c-worthy (that’s cheese-worthy) with more full-bodied curds, such as TJ’s Cheddar & Gruyere Melange, or paired with a hearty platter of Wedge Salad Dip and tortilla chips.
We’re selling Boatswain Double I.P.A. in six-packs of 12-ounce cans for $4.99. You could search the seven seas and still not find a Double I.P.A. of this stature at such an amazing price!

blocks.html: The best burger building resembles a ballet... Imagine a choreographed romp that quietly begins with a pirouetting patty, leaning back into the arms of a resting bun. This sets the stage for spinning spreads, plié-ing pickles, and a whole company of dancing plants. A tutu of sliced cheese hangs over the patty’s edge, while the top-bun descends, crowning this meat-iated masterpiece like a golden-brown tiara... (If you have a hard time picturing all this, just watch the video below.)

Just like this burger ballet, we believe the best burgers are sponsored by Trader Joe’s. So, visit your neighborhood store for access to all the en pointe accoutrements—at values that are tutu good to pass up! Then raise the curtain on your backyard barbeque and get to grilling.

Check our bakery racks for a bevy of buns and bun-worthy breads, from Brioche Buns to good old fashioned Hamburger Buns. We also have a multiplicity of meats, like our pre-formed Patties, or our 80/20 Ground Beef—in case you like to do the patty-forming yourself. When it comes to TJ's Cheeses, there are so many options, you may just want to ask a Crew Member to suggest their favorite!

Organic Ketchup is legendary in our stores. Other TJ's condiment icons include our Organic Mayo and our Organic Yellow Mustard. Beyond these burger-essentials, we also sell a variety of TJ's Dips, Sauces & Dressings that can further elevate the space between your burger and bun. Come walk our grocery aisles and see if our enthusiasm for condiments spreads!

Tender burgers beg for complementary crunch. Luckily, our litany of lettuces can oblige. Try a couple crisp leaves of Romaine Hearts, for example. With a subtler crunch, our pre-sliced Organic Kosher Sandwich Pickles also bring some zing to the stack. And if it’s extra umami you’re after, slice some TJ's Campari Tomatoes to add physical height and flavorful depth to your summer sandwich.

blocks.description:
As the name suggests, a smash burger is a thin burger patty that's been smashed with a spatula during the cooking process. The edges become crispy while the middle remains satisfyingly succulent, thanks to the 80/20 lean-to-fat ratio of Trader Joe’s Ground Beef Patties. Each package comes with four portioned Patties, so you can make four burgers… or you can double down on that smash-burger goodness as we’ve suggested below. 

Pro-tip: For smash-burger success, ensure your cook surface is non-stick or seasoned so the burgers don’t stick when it’s time to flip. To prevent sticking to the spatula, lightly oil the bottom before you smash!

blocks.html: How do you know it’s fall? When Trader Joe’s Spiced Cider arrives on our shelves! Our Spiced Cider has been a reliable autumnal indicator for more than 20 years. The 64 fluid-ounce bottle holds the juice of U.S.A.-grown, bursting-with-flavor apples that have been brewed with just the right amount of cinnamon, allspice, and cloves to give each sip that soothing seasonal warmth.

It’s also worth noting that for all its apple-y spiced sweetness, there’s absolutely no added sugar—and just when you think the flavor has fully revealed itself, you’ll discover a subtle hint of citrus on the finish, derived from orange & lemon peels!

If all this isn’t enough to get you excidered... it’s time to consult the crows. The crows know! To discover exactly what Trader Joe’s crows know about TJ’s Spiced Cider, it’s time to watch the video...

blocks.html: Every year, students, academics, and fans of arithmetical puns the world over celebrate Pi Day on March 14th (as in, 3.14), in honor of one of mathematics’ most curious constants. Often, that celebration involves plenty of pies, pizza and otherwise. But if you ask us, we figure that every day ought to be Pi Day—especially if that means bringing even more pizza into the equation. So, as a tribute to our favorite irrational number (better luck next time, square root of two!), we’ve put together this sequence of some of our tastiest frozen pizzas to help you celebrate Pi Day, all year long!

Made for us by a supplier in Naples, based on the classic Neapolitan street food pizza fritta, our Roasted Garlic & Pesto Pizza with a Deep Fried Crust has some pretty impressive numbers of its own. First, our supplier matures the dough for 90 hours, then lets it ferment for an additional six, and is folded, by hand, three times a day throughout the whole process. Then, it’s shaped, also by hand, and fried until satisfyingly crisp, before it’s topped with a four cheese blend of burrata, mozzarella, provolone, and Parmigiano Reggiano, and finished with dollops of fresh basil pesto and roasted garlic.

Once it reaches your kitchen, it only takes 15 minutes in the oven before it’s bubbly, aromatic, and ready to serve. All that adds up to one easy, delicious dinner!

When two casual-cuisine icons come together in one incredible entrée, it’s always a treat. But when those two icons come together in a form that lets non meat-eaters in on the fun, too? Well, that’s nothing short of Meatless mathe-magic. That’s exactly how we’d describe Trader Joe’s Vegetarian Meatless Cheeseburger Pizza, a tasty take on a perennial pizza parlor favorite.

Layered with bold Cheddar cheese, diced red onion & tomato, and sliced sweet pickles, as well as a tangy burger sauce and crumbles of savory-seasoned, plant-based protein, each bite of this Pizza evokes the fun, familiar flavors of a fully loaded cheeseburger.

Gluten free options don’t have to settle on being just good-for-gluten-free. They can be outright delicious, and Trader Joe's Gluten Free Pizza with a Cauliflower Crust is proof positive. What's the secret? A flawlessly formulated crust made with cauliflower, mozzarella cheese, and a blend of potato, chickpea, and brown rice flour.

It cooks just as a pizza should, with a soft bite in the center and satisfyingly crisp edges, which serve to complement the tangy tomato sauce and mix of mozzarella and provolone cheeses on top. It's delicious (and not just delicious-for-gluten-free, mind you) as is, or when customized with your own favorite toppings, right before baking. Yum. Gluten Free Pizza party, anyone?

What gives? Friends do! Especially when they’re invited to a Thanksgiving-adjacent celebration along with pals, mates, and amigos of all kinds.

It’s customary for hosts to request that friends furnish food for such a fête—but what to bring? Trader Joe's will help you decide: First, check your invitation. Then watch this video for inspiration. (And scroll down for more product details.)

Finally, visit our store to pick up any apps, sides, desserts, and beverages you want to share with friends as you gather to give thanks for each other!

Appetizers are often requested by party hosts, and Trader Joe’s has no shortage of choices in this category. While a variety can be found all around our stores, some of the most popular apps are found in our freezers. Trader Joe’s Pastry Bites with Feta Cheese & Caramelized Onions is a tasty example.

A package includes twelve, bite-sized, buttery puff pastries, each one filled with rich feta and cream cheeses, and topped with caramelized onions. The combination of a flaky texture with complementary sweet and savory flavors is a hit, no matter who’s taking a Bite! Each 8.5-ounce package of Pastry Bites is $4.99.

When asked to bring a side, it may be hard to decide. You can always bring a hot side dish, but bringing a salad instead can make it easier on you and your host. Even better when it has a seasonal theme, like Trader Joe’s Harvest Apple Salad Kit!

This Kit includes a spring mix (for fall!) of fresh, fluffy greens, like spinach, butter lettuce, radicchio, arugula, and more (mix varies by region). Also included are shreds of Unexpected Cheddar; crisp, dried apple chips with cinnamon; and crunchy pecan pieces. A packet of sweet & tangy apple vinaigrette tops it all off. Each 9.2-ounce package is $3.99. You'll find it in our refrigerated produce section.

Stuffing is one of the most important dishes at Friendsgiving, so if you were asked to bring it, you must be important, too! We’re not advocating favorites, here—unless you’re talking about stuffing mixes... in which case, we’d have to say that Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Stuffing Mix is right up there with the best.

The base consists of gluten-free croutons, which have been lightly toasted and seasoned with savory herbs. At your host’s house, add butter and water, then heat it on the stovetop, or in an oven casserole dish. You can also cook it old school, stuffed inside the bird. And this Stuffing has an old school price: each 12.4-ounce package is $5.99!

If you’re asked to bring the final flourish of the Friendsgiving feast, don’t sweat it—just get it at Trader Joe’s! In our bakery section, you'll find tender, nine-inch, fluted crusts filled with rich, creamy custard that's made with pumpkin purée and accented by ground cinnamon, ground ginger, and a hint of cloves. Each 27-ounce Pumpkin Pie serves 6-8 friends, and sells for $6.99.

For a fruitier dessert, try Trader Joe’s French Apple Tart. The shortbread crust is filled with a mix of sliced Granny Smith and Northern Spy apples, plus some sliced apricots. Its fantastic, fruity character includes a hint of vanilla and is excellent warmed with a scoop of TJ’s Ice Cream. Each 20-ounce Tart is $7.99.

It's not uncommon for a host to say, "Just bring yourself... no need to bring anything else." Of course, this is your cue to head to the Trader Joe's wine section and pick up one of our Grand Reserves.

There's almost always a Grand Reserve on our shelves, like this Trader Joe's Grand Reserve Carneros Pinot Noir. It's dark-red, complex, and full-bodied, with notes of red cherry, baking spice, and black tea. Each sip delivers robust fruit and velvety tannins. At $12.99 for a 750mL bottle (the same price as all our Grand Reserves) this is an incredible value, especially when similar wines might go for twice as much elsewhere!

If wine's not your jam, you might opt for a voluminous, fresh bouquet instead. Like our wines, there's always something new to discover. Our large Seasonal Bouquets are artfully designed using the most vibrant flowers and greens of the season. And for $12.99 each, you'll come off as the graceful guest, without breaking the bank.

The Cold Brew process has cemented its status as pinnacle percolator of coffee bar culture. What separates the wheat from the chaff—or the coffee cherry from the bean, as it were? As its name puts forth, Cold Brew Coffee is never heated. As a result, the oils and acids that are commonly released with heat don’t pass through to the brew.

To quantify it, a cup of Cold Brew Coffee contains about 50% less acid than a hot-brewed cup. No longer masked by the compounds that give coffee its bitter bite, the lush, fruity flavors of the beans become strikingly more perceptible—and to many, that much more enjoyable.

Trader Joe’s Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate lives up to the aforementioned Cold Brew reputation with aplomb. It marries what coffee geeks covet—technique, quality, taste—with what Trader Joe’s geeks cherish—value. Working with craft coffee roasters in the Bay Area, we start with a half-pound of medium roasted, 100% Arabica beans from the world’s finest coffee-growing regions. The beans are coarsely ground and specially cold-filtered to create naturally sweet, ready-to-pour Trader Joe’s Cold Brewed Coffee Concentrate. Keep in mind, that’s a process that would take anywhere between 12-to-24 hours to do on your own. That’s a long time to wait for the joyful brew that we bring straight to your cup.

At $7.99* for each bottle of our 32 ounce Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate—equivalent to about 96 ounces of coffee beverages when reconstituted with water, milk, etc.—we make that cup wicked affordable. To break it down, each serving of Trader Joe’s Cold Brew Coffee is about 66¢. If you were to pick up a bottle or cup at any other retailer, you’d expect to pay at least two to three times that amount.

We’re all in on Hoisin! As a matter of fact, we’re such big fans of the stuff that we’ve decided to make Trader Joe’s Hoisin Sauce the star of our next Customer Recipe Contest! 

Named for the Cantonese word for “seafood,” Hoisin Sauce gets its moniker not by virtue of containing seafood as an ingredient (ours is vegan), but rather from the fact that its rich aromas and umami undertones evoke that ineffable, subtly seafood-y quality that’s so celebrated in Szechuan cuisine. Its sticky-sweet and savory flavor and its luxurious, velvety texture make it one of the most versatile condiments around... Perfect for a creative, culinary challenge, don’t you think? 

Customers across the country, let the #TJsHoisinContest commence!

CREATE IT: Using Trader Joe’s Hoisin Sauce and up to six (6) additional TJ’s ingredients, create an original recipe to WOW our judges.   

  • All ingredients must be Trader Joe’s products. A Trader Joe’s product is defined as anything currently sold and purchased in our stores.
  • Trader Joe’s salt, pepper, sugar, butter, cooking oils, and water are considered freebies; their use will not count towards your seven-ingredient maximum. Just be sure to tell us if and how you used them in your caption. (See “Caption It,” below.)
  • You can interpret the theme however you like—get creative!

SNAP IT: Take an original photo of your creation.

  • Only photos are eligible for consideration; video submissions will be disqualified.
  • Photos cannot contain any added text overlay, graphics, or watermarks.
  • Any garnishes pictured on or in the dish must be listed and will count as ingredients.
  • Remember, Instagram is a visual medium, so lighting, focus, etc. are important.

CAPTION IT: You must include a complete list of ingredients, recipe instructions, and the contest hashtag—#TJsHoisinContest—in your caption. Entries without ingredients and instructions in the caption will not be considered. An image of the written recipe will not count.

POST IT: Post your image and caption to your own Instagram account between Monday, March 31, 2025 at 9:00 a.m. PDT and Sunday, April 13, 2025, at 11:59 p.m. PDT. Please note, your Instagram account must be set to “public” to participate in this contest; if your account is set to “private,” we won’t be able to see your entry!

One winner will be selected by our panel to receive a $200 Trader Joe’s gift card and have their recipe featured on the Trader Joe’s website. Two runners-up will be selected to each receive a $100 Trader Joe’s gift card. All three winning entries will be featured on the @traderjoes Instagram account when contest results are announced.

A panel of super-official foodies (a.k.a. Trader Joe’s Crew Members) will select one (1) Winner and two (2) Runners-up from all eligible entries based on the following criteria:

  • Taste (60%) – Above all else, it’s gotta be delicious.
  • Photo (30%) – We’re looking for great composition, focus, lighting, etc. — your image should leave us dying to try your dish! 
  • Creativity (10%) – Bonus points for originality, interesting ingredients, unexpected flavor combos, etc.

Entry Period & Submission Deadline: The Contest officially beings at 9:00 a.m. PDT on Monday, March 31, 2025. You may post your photo anytime between then and 11:59 p.m. PDT on Sunday, April 13, 2025. No entries posted after this date and time will be eligible.

Notification & Announcement of Winners: One winner and two runners-up will be announced publicly on Instagram on Monday, April 28, 2025, via the @traderjoes Instagram account and traderjoes.com. Winners will be notified prior to this public announcement via an Instagram Direct Message (DM) from @traderjoes. Important info regarding notification:

  • Notification will be sent on or about Friday, April 18th—check your DMs!
  • Winners will be asked for their email addresses and sent official Prize Acceptance Documents.
  • Documents must be signed and returned—along with any requested digital files of winning images—within 48 hours of receipt.
  • If winners fail to provide email addresses, return signed documents, and/or send digital image files within the designated time frame, their winning entries may be disqualified.

Can’t wait to see what you cook up!

As summer winds its way to a close, you’ll want to take the opportunity to savor every last drop. You may be surprised that we recommend ending it on a sour note—or more specifically, with a sour mash whiskey.

Trader Joe’s Kentucky Bourbon Straight Whiskey is a sour mash Whiskey, which refers to the inclusion of liquid from a previous distillation (the backset) in each new distillation. Think of it as the “sourdough starter” of whiskey. The backset helps to ensure consistent flavor from batch to batch by passing along some of the characteristics of previous batches; here, that includes sweet, fruity, and spicy notes, with hints of brown sugar and oak. The characteristically long, dry, spicy finish delivers lingering vanilla on your palate.

If you’re a whiskey aficionado, you’ll appreciate the value ours represents. If you’re new to Bourbon, this Kentucky Bourbon Straight Whiskey is a great place to start, especially because our fantastic price of $14.99* for a 750mL bottle means you’re taking very little risk in the purchase.

Now for some technical notes: the mash bill is proprietary to this particular product, and contains a blend of corn, rye, and malted barley. Generally speaking, Bourbon Whiskies must be aged a minimum of two years in new, charred oak containers. Our Kentucky Bourbon Straight Whiskey is aged a minimum of five years. Sip it straight. Enjoy it on the rocks. Make yourself an old-fashioned Old Fashioned, or whip up a spiked strawberry lemonade and squeeze every last drop out of summer. Cheers!

blocks.html: Lush, verdant vineyards, a tranquil riverside locale, and climate-controlled, historically significant caves… this could be the setting of a French romance, and in many ways it is. This is the milieu in which one of our favorite sparkling wines, La Burgondie Crémant de Bourgogne, is carefully crafted. And what’s more romantic than sparkling wine from France?

blocks.title: La Burgondie Crémant de Bourgogne - How It's Made

blocks.html: Dedicated winemakers—with generations of experience—begin with grapes cultivated by a collective of local farmers. The grapes are picked by hand and delivered to the winery immediately after harvest, then crushed upon arrival.

The resulting “juice” is fermented in stainless steel tanks; then, according to the traditional method, the wine is bottled, and undergoes a secondary fermentation in the bottle—this is where the bubbles are produced. Our supplier utilizes their temperature-controlled caves for this step of the fermentation process. When secondary fermentation is complete, the wine is bottled and ready to enjoy.

Our cameras were on site in Burgundy to capture the making of this stellar sparkler, from start to finish.* It’s a delightful dichotomy—old-school expertise and methodology meets high-tech equipment and efficiency—that delivers equally delightful drinking.

Syrah, Grenache, and Cinsault grapes come from the Ventoux appellation (formerly Côtes du Ventoux) in the greater Rhône Valley wine region of southern France.

Limited time on the skins leaves behind a pleasing light pink with pastel highlights. These visual delights are amplified by the aromas of delicate red fruits, fresh flowers, and citrus. And after such preliminaries, your palate will only continue to applaud the persistent fresh fruit notes that are delivered dry (but not exceedingly so) with a clean finish.

Chilled, La Ferme Julien Rosé is superb on a sunny summer afternoon in the backyard… or barnyard, if that’s your kind of thing. Have a glass with grilled chicken or salmon. Or casually couple it with Brie and a baguette. Either way, Joe’s has got your goat—and this is nothing to be irritated about. Au contraire! With this singular nut—actually legume, as it grows beneath the soil’s surface—you can take your tastebuds on a delicious adventure that includes every meal of the day, plus a span of sweet and savory flavors.

The shelves at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s provide opportunity for actualization of this nut-legume culinary journey. Here, we humbly present a plethora of products and recipes in which the unpretentious peanut plays a principal role. Take notes on your favorites... then take nuts home from your neighborhood Trader Joe’s to embark on your own peanutty exploits.

This Peanut Butter is made with just two ingredients: peanuts and salt. That’s it.

Without any additives, you’re left with peanut butter that actually tastes like… peanuts! The nuts are dry roasted with skins on, which really enhances the flavor of the finished peanut butter.

From ready-to-eat refrigerated favorites and shelf-stable standbys, to pantry basics you can stir up from scratch, your neighborhood Trader Joe’s is here to satisfy your hankering for a hearty soup du jour (any jour of the semaine).

Come to think of it, even our freezer case is full of ingredients that can go from sauté to soup bowl in mere minutes—take for instance, Trader Joe’s Chicken Gyoza Potstickers. Super when steamed, and fantastic when fried up in a skillet (and dipped in TJ's Gyoza Dipping Sauce, of course)… these delightful dumplings are equally excellent when added to a belly-warming bowl of soup! Watch the video and review the recipe that follows—it’s a weeknight wonder of a recipe to keep on hand when the weather turns chilly.

blocks.description: Gyoza are super when steamed, and fantastic when fried up in a skillet (and dipped in TJ's Gyoza Dipping Sauce, of course)… but do you want know another way to enjoy these delicious dumplings? According to culinary historians, gyoza (“jiaozi” in Mandarin) were invented by the Chinese. It’s rumored that the potsticker came to be when a Chinese chef walked away from the stove while gyoza were boiling—the water boiled off, and the stuffed dumplings stuck to the wok. The crisped side proved to be quite pleasing.

Because we love good food stories as much as we love good dumplings, once upon a time (in 1993, to be exact), we developed our very own Chicken Gyoza Potstickers. These crescent-shaped, two-to-three bite-sized dumplings are made from chewy, wheat flour wrappers that enfold a flavorful filling of chicken, cabbage and onion, seasoned with soy sauce, sesame seed oil and ginger powder. Keep a couple of bags in your freezer and you’ll never be too far away from an awesome appetizer—or a scrumptious bowl of soup!

It’s one of our most cherished traditions: at the beginning of every year, we reach out to our customers and ask them to vote for their favorite products in the Trader Joe’s Customer Choice Awards. As the years have gone on, some products have so consistently won in their category (or even multiple categories) that we felt the time was right to take them out of contention, so that other products might get their turn in the spotlight. At the same time, we wanted to make sure these overachievers were given their due recognition—something permanent.

So, back in 2023 we created the Trader Joe’s Product Hall of Fame and inducted its first class of honorees, each at least a five-time winner of their respective categories.

Here in this hallowed Hall, you’ll find some of the very best of the very best that Trader Joe’s has to offer. We invite you take a tour, at your leisure, and learn a bit about each product’s proud legacy. You might just find yourself inspired to head to your neighborhood TJ’s and try them for yourself…

Considered by many to be the crown jewel of the Trader Joe’s produce section, our Teeny Tiny Avocados have garnered a great big fanbase over the years. And for good reason! They have so many facets to fawn over, from their convenient, single-serving stature, to their sterling value for a six-count bag. Would it be too precious of us to propose a congratulatory toast? Shine on, Teeny Tiny Avocados! Shine on!

Among the all-star cast of our autumnal product lineup, Trader Joe’s Spiced Cider has to be first on the call sheet—it’s certainly first in many of our customers’ hearts. In addition to its sweet, tangy, mulling-spice flavor profile, this leading libation also acts as a kind of bellwether beverage, signaling the start of our fall season the moment it hits our shelves each year. And if you want to talk about range, our Spiced Cider’s got it, serving well in both hot and cold settings. Bravo!

Now far and away the most recent product ever inducted into the Trader Joe’s Product Hall of Fame, and by a seven-year margin, it’d be fair to call Trader Joe’s Chili & Lime Flavored Rolled Corn Tortilla Chips the Rookie of the Decade. Covering four different bases of flavor with their tantalizing tanginess, scintillating citrus-iness, spectacular spice, and world-class crunch, these Rolled Tortilla Chips always knock it out of the park—especially when you make a line drive to dunk them into some guacamole. Swing by your Trader Joe’s to catch a bag, today!

It would be hard to imagine Trader Joe’s without Trader Joe’s Mandarin Orange Chicken. Beloved for its ease of preparation, spectacularly sweet & savory profile, and unbeatable value, this fun and flavorful phenom made a clean sweep of Favorite Overall and Best Entrée multiple years in a row. Our customers have made it more than clear: this Orange Chicken always takes home the gold.

A crowning achievement of confectionery, Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups were instant favorites among our customers from the moment they made their debut. By placing a rich, Dark Chocolate twist on a classic candy combo, these sweet treats elevate both elements of its familiar formula to entirely new dimensions. Join us in raising a glass to these Cups: may they always be our customers’ cup of tea.

Some snacks get by on flash and panache—and we love them all the more for it. Other snacks, like Trader Joe’s Peanut Butter Filled Pretzel Nuggets, are masters of the fundamentals. Having put in more than 30 years of work with the kind of reliably delicious, lunch-pail snacking that the whole team can depend on, these veterans of the snack section have been a long time coming into the Hall of Fame, and we’re delighted to see them get their due. Thank you for always being the kind of sweet and salty snack that our customers really dig, Nuggets!

Ironically enough, it isn’t the least bit surprising to see Trader Joe’s Unexpected Cheddar achieve this accolade. As a smooth, creamy Cheddar that shares some saporous similarities with aged Parmesan, our Unexpected Cheddar could have reached iconic status for its one-two punch of sharp and tangy flavor alone. But its sheer versatility is what sets it over the top, be it as part of a charcuterie plate, a baked macaroni and cheese dish, or one knockout of a grilled cheese sandwich. Pound for pound, our Unexpected Cheddar is exactly what you’d expect a champion to be.

When the chips (or tacos, or frittatas) are down, Trader Joe’s Soy Chorizo is exactly the kind of vegan protein you want to have on your team. Because it's an all-around favorite among vegans, vegetarians, and omnivores alike, deploying this perfectly seasoned Soy Chorizo in your quesadillas, omelets, and breakfast hashes is always a winning play. In an increasingly competitive field of plant-based options, we’re glad to see this Chorizo secure its status as MVP—Magnificent Vegan Protein, that is.

blocks.html: France is known the world over for its dedication to haute cuisine, but that doesn’t mean you have to brave a transatlantic flight to indulge in its everyday delights. Zip on over to your friendly neighborhood Trader Joe’s instead!

In fact, all it takes to transform your kitchen into a Parisian café is a crusty Organic French Baguette ($1.99 for 11.5 oz.), preferably warmed up in an oven for a few minutes, and our exquisitely rich and creamy Cultured Salted Butter ($3.69 for 8.8 oz.), brought to us from a creamery in Brittany, France. Feel free to complete this Seine-side scene with a chilled glass of bright and refreshing La Ferme Julien Rosé ($5.99* for 750mL), un vin extraordinaire from Côte de Ventoux, served alongside a plate of buttery, indulgent St. André Triple Crème Brie for ($11.99 per pound) — the best price you’ll find this side of Marseille. As they say, bon appétit!

As any archeophile can attest, Italy offers it all in the way ancient delights. And as any foodie can affirm, the beloved “boot” of the Mediterranean also offers it all in the way of comforting cuisine.

Start your journey with a mini, made-in-Italia charcuterie board, complete with mild, buttery slices of Uncured Salame di Parma ($5.49 for 4 oz.) and tidy triangles of Italian Truffle Cheese ($12.99 per pound). Then, do as the Romans do, by bidding homage to Bacchus with a generous pour of Villa Cerrina Montepulciano D’Abruzzo ($4.99* for 750mL). With its even-handed, fruity flavors and ample tannic structure, it’s no wonder it’s TJ’s top-selling Italian red!

Next, celebrate Sicily with our seasonal Ricotta & Lemon Zest Ravioli ($3.49 for 8.8 oz.), tossed in our finest Sicilian Selezione Extra Virgin Olive Oil ($7.99 for 16.9 fl. oz.) One forkful of these tender, golden pockets of pasta, and you’ll feel like you’re frolicking in a field of Tuscan girasole. Speaking of pasta, before you depart for the next nation, be sure to bounce on over to Bari – the capital city of the southern Puglia region – for a bowl of our Organic Italian Artisan Gigli Pasta ($2.69 for 17.6 oz.). Our vendor makes it just for us, and aside from being utterly delicious, its ribbon-like structure and ruffled edges mean this pasta really holds its sauce...

Picture yourself basking by the ancient shores of the Mediterranean, taking in the sights and savoring the treats of a nearby taverna. Sounds lovely, no? While we can’t replicate the beach, we can certainly provide much of the edible experience with our authentically Greek fare.

Whether it’s a modern twist on an old favorite like our tangy and texturally satisfying Quinoa Stuffed Dolmas ($2.99 for 9.96 oz.), a super-sized snackable like our plump and fruity Giant Chalkidiki Olives ($2.29 for 7.6 oz.), or tapas-like showstoppers like our perfectly seasoned Greek Chickpeas with Parsley & Cumin ($1.79 for 9.88 oz.) and Giant Baked Beans in Tomato Sauce ($1.99 for 9.6 oz.), we have everything you need to make a masterful mezze platter and more. If that weren’t enough, who can say no to a slice of our flaky, oh-so-satisfying, serves-six Greek Spanakopita Authentic Spinach & Cheese Pie ($3.99 for 14 oz.)? Not us…

As the second most populous nation on earth, India is home to countless culinary traditions and foodways. Made for us by a supplier in India, our Indian Fare Pouches draw inspiration from a variety of popular regional delicacies...

Our hearty and savory Jaipur Vegetables ($1.99 for 10 oz.) harken to the creamy curries that hail from the capital city of Rajasthan; our bold & buttery Madras Lentils ($1.99 for 10 oz.) are based on the famed spiced curries thought to have originated in Chennai; our spicy and aromatic Yellow Tadka Dal ($1.99 for 10 oz.) is an adaptation of a tempered lentil recipe considered to be as old as time itself; while our creamy & flavorful Tikka Vegetables ($1.99 for 10 oz.) are an homage to the tomato-based tikka masala curries popular in India and abroad.

All can be stored in your pantry and prepared in mere minutes, and all pair wonderfully with a bit of warm Tandoori Naan ($1.99 for 12 oz. – find it in our freezers) and fluffy, long-grained Organic Basmati Rice ($4.49 for 2 lbs.).

It’s almost impossible to capture the colorful, unassailable splendor of Thailand in a paragraph. Fortunately for you, what we can’t capture in words, we can capture in a Thai-inspired Staycation spread, brought to your table straight from Thailand, vis-à-vis your neighborhood Trader Joe’s!

While you wait for your mains to microwave, munch on a handful of our perennially popular Thai Lime & Chili Cashews ($7.99 for 1 lb.) The ground lime leaves can only temper the heat of the chili pepper for so long, though, so you’ll want to have a chilled bottle of fresh, single-origin Organic Coconut Water ($1.99 for 10 fl. oz.) on hand to hydrate. (And yes, that pretty-in-pink hue is completely natural—this blushing beverage contains just one ingredient: water from organic Namhom coconuts, grown in the Ratchaburi Province.)

Ding! Did you hear that? Why, it must be your microwave, letting you know that your vegan Vegetable Pad Thai ($2.99 for 10.5 oz.) and Spicy Thai Shrimp Fried Rice ($4.99 for 16 oz.) are ready! Fasten your seatbelts, folks — in just a few bites, you’ll basically be sampling street food in bustling Bangkok night market...

blocks.title: Zoom On Over To New Zealand

blocks.html: For the last leg of this truly spectacular Summer Staycation, let us lead you through the lush, green pastures of New Zealand, where moderate temperatures and flowing mountain streams make for fields of clover and grass for-the-grazing all year long. Don't worry, the only grazing you’ll be doing is in your kitchen, but the local cows’ grass diet definitely works to your advantage.

The milk these Kiwi cows produce is exceptionally rich and flavorful (and free from rBST), which means our New Zealand Sharp Cheddar ($6.49 per pound), aged 6-12 months, is equally rich and flavorful… and the consummate companion to a glass of Picton Bay Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc ($6.99* for 750mL). Sauvignon blancs from Marlborough — the northeast corner of the South Island — have really solidified New Zealand's standing on the international wine stage, and after just one sip, you won't wonder why. Picton Bay is fresh and vibrant with a clean grassiness, concentrated fruitiness, and a crisp, lingering finish.

It kind of reminds us of a Granny Smith apple… and Granny Smith apples kind of remind us of our final featured food: Organic Kiwis ($3.29 for 1 lb.)**! Come on, you didn’t think we’d take you to New Zealand without offering you a kiwi, did you? After all this traveling together, we’d think you’d know us better than that...

Once upon a time, in the Southwest of England, a unique cheese was born. While Cheddar cheese is now made ‘round the world, its origins can be traced to the bucolic town of Cheddar (yes, such a place actually exists). Some of the world’s best Cheddar is still made in this region, whose verdant pastures are home to the cows that provide the rich, luscious milk from which the cheese is made. We traveled to the English countryside and paid a visit to one of that country’s most respected and award-winning cheesemakers, just a short drive from the town of Cheddar itself.

One of the things that makes Cheddar unique is the “cheddaring” process – the constant stacking and turning of the “loaves” of curds, which helps to remove additional whey (liquid). When the cheddaring is complete, the cheese is prepared for aging, which can take anywhere from a few months to a few years. The longer the cheese is aged, the more complex its character becomes.

Some (very special) Cheddars are aged in caves, which impart additional complexity of flavor and texture. Plus, the caves are really cool (both literally and figuratively, actually)!

Let’s take a drive through the English countryside. We wind through (very narrow) roads and paths never really intended for automobiles, continually marveling at the history of the ancient villages along the way, and eventually we find ourselves at an established estate, idyllically situated between the rolling Dorset Downs and the craggy Jurassic Coast. For more than 45 years, traditional English cheeses have been produced at this site, and over time, these traditional cheesemakers have expanded their offerings to include some not-so-traditional creations, including Trader Joe’s Cheddar Cheese with Caramelized Onions.

Starting with a classic farmhouse Cheddar made with fresh, locally-sourced milk, the skilled cheesemakers blend in precise amounts of custom-crafted Caramelized Onion marmalade. The finished cheese is incredibly rich, yet somehow delicate, savory and simultaneously showcases a bit of sweetness. Cheeseboards were made for cheeses like this – it offers a distinct point of view, and pairs well with all kinds of crackers, dried fruits, cured meats, and olives. It’s also an excellent cheese for melting – think burgers, grilled cheese sandwiches, or mac & cheese! It’s a truly memorable cheese.

Fancy a peek at how it’s made and its journey to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s? It’s just a click away…

Every Trader Joe’s store is a distinct reflection of the neighborhood in which it resides. From the actual physical structure of the store, to the arrangement of the products and displays inside, and, most importantly, its customers and Crew, each and every Trader Joe's is different, specific, and unique.

Of course, there are a few that are…just slightly more different, a touch more specific, and unique in their own particularly unique way. Below, we’ve assembled a list to highlight just a handful of our quirkiest stores, courtesy of some of America’s most notable neighborhoods.

Situated in Manhattan’s Upper West Side, a mere two city blocks from Central Park, our 72nd & Broadway store is hands down the busiest Trader Joe’s in the world. Covering two stories (three, if you count the entrance) and serviced by no less than two elevators and four escalators, 72nd & Broadway has about thrice as many checkstands and thrice as many Crew Members as a typical TJ’s.

This may sound daunting, but to our Manhattan customers and Crew, it’s just another neighborhood store.

Woodland Hills may seem like an unassuming Trader Joe’s out in California’s San Fernando Valley, but it’s got a great, big (but not-terribly-well-kept) secret: the largest wine section of any TJ’s on the West Coast!

Towering displays of California Cabs and Spanish Verdejo stand alongside a cooler reserved just for beer and sparkling wine. Indeed, stacks and stacks of your favorite Trader Joe’s wines await you in Woodland Hills, along with a few special wines you can’t find at any other Trader Joe’s.

About half the size of most of our stores, but with all the same products, South Pasadena is one of our longest running Trader Joe’s, and the very definition of a neighborhood store. In fact, many customers in South Pas were still shopping here when it was operating as our predecessor, Pronto Market, 50 years ago!

The smaller footprint only further contributes to the close, tight-knit community feeling, as customers and Crew get to know each other quite well—impromptu mid-aisle dance parties are not uncommon.

Occupying the entire second floor of a former office building (the former site of an insurance firm), our Bethesda store sits a little higher than most other Trader Joe’s, but is just as grounded in its community.

In fact, in this markedly multilingual community, you’ll likely hear Crew Members and customers alike conversing in French, Arabic, and Wolof (the language of Gambia, Mauritania, and Senegal), in addition to English.

One of a small number of underground Trader Joe’s, our Pacific Place store ingeniously avoids the problem of a small parking lot by…not having a parking lot to begin with. Located in a heavily foot-trafficked street, just a stone’s throw away from San Francisco’s Moscone Center, locals on their lunch break shop alongside visiting conventioneers.

Just about every language in the world can be heard spoken among our customers and Crew, making Pacific Place the closest thing we have to an international neighborhood store.

You’re not just seeing things—we actually put a Trader Joe’s inside an old movie theater! Outside, the marquee advertises our blockbusting new products, while inside, our sign artists take residence in the theater’s old mezzanine level. They fill the store with beautiful signage, sculptures, and other décor to celebrate the artistic community in Houston – including a foam vehicular tribute to the annual Houston Art Car Parade.

You would be forgiven for mistaking our Court Street store in Brooklyn, NY for a Trader Joe’s Savings & Loan. What was once a local branch office of a bank is now the neighborhood store for northwest Brooklyn, though the beautiful marble, high ceilings, and arched windows remain—as does an old vault in the back room. This store is so immersed in local history, that it’s even been designated as a protected historical site: on the wall outside, a plaque commemorates that George Washington was once stationed here during the Battle of Long Island in 1776.

Another underground Trader Joe’s, our Back Bay store also carries the confirmed distinction of being the single smallest Trader Joe’s in existence. The Crew gets quite creative with the space in order to serve our many student customers from nearby Boston University, MIT, and Berklee College of Music.

Just like the neighborhood, this store is constantly in motion, especially at checkout: rather than queue up individually at each checkstand, customers in Back Bay all enter one quickly-moving line to save space.

Our Media store doesn’t just honor the history of this charming neighborhood, it’s a part of it. We’ve stationed this store in the historically preserved Armory of the 111th Infantry of the Pennsylvania National Guard, which now also houses the PA Veterans Museum in the basement.

Folks from the neighborhood stop on by not just to shop, but reminisce about when the Armory was used by local schools as a gymnasium, and to host sock hops in the 1950’s and 60’s.

Where it all began. The first Trader Joe’s is still serving its neighborhood after more than 50 years—and many of our customers have been with us since the very beginning. Some of the products may have changed, but the store—and its parking lot—certainly haven’t. We’re still just as excited to offer fascinating foods at exceptional values and be, as the big red sign over Arroyo Parkway proudly states, “Your Neighborhood Grocery Store.”

Does the thought of hosting a holiday meal send you into a tailspin? Worry not—your neighborhood Trader Joe’s has everything you need for planning fall festivities, especially when it comes to that fourth Thursday in November. And now, even more autumnally inspired products are arriving in our stores, this time with a twist—the Thanksgiving Twist! 

What’s the Thanksgiving Twist? It’s Trader Joe’s take on the best quality Thanksgiving essentials and exclusive-to-us goodies, which we offer at the best prices you won’t find anywhere else. In other words, our “twist” is value! And at this time of year—when you’re feeding friends and family in addition to your regular crew—the TJ’s value-twist means even more. 

Great value aside, we’ve taken care of the prep work—think brined turkeys, pre-cut vegetables, heat & eat appetizers and side dishes, and showstopping pies—to ensure your time in the kitchen is enjoyable, yet brief, so you can get back to what matters most: celebrating with your loved ones and giving thanks! 

All the products in this feature are either already in our stores or coming soon. Browse them, then visit your neighborhood Trader Joe’s to do the twist with us. The dance floor’s open!

Burritos, pitas, sandwiches…there’s no denying that handheld meals are, well, handy. They make it easy to enjoy every component of your meal with each mouthwatering bite, and they come with an edible wrapper for the ultimate in palate-pleasing portability (we’re looking at you, tortillas, pitas, and sliced bread!).

With the seemingly endless number of wrapper-filling combinations out there, finding the perfect burrito preparation isn't as difficult as it sounds—simply take a trip to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. Just about any of our fabulous frozen entrées make a terrific lunch or delicious dinner on their own, but with a few extra ingredients and just a couple more minutes of prep, you could have a new desk-friendly lunch or on-the-go dinner creation in your hands—such as a Spicy Kung Pao Rollup, Spinach & Artichoke Chicken Wrap, or Tikka Masala Burrito...

A consistent member of the Trader Joe’s Customer Choice Awards winners circle, Trader Joe’s Chicken Tikka Masala boasts chunks of roasted chicken served in a creamy, mildly spicy, tomato-based, curry flavored sauce. Our Chicken Tikka Masala was so favored for so many years, in fact, that we developed a vegan version to live alongside it in our frozen case. With a base of soy protein in place of meat, and bathed in an equally flavorful, slightly spicy sauce, Trader Joe’s Vegan Tikka Masala skyrocketed to fame and earned a coveted spot in our Customer Choice Awards, right alongside its meat-based counterpart.

While either of these Indian entrées are incredible served as-is, they’re cleverly complemented in the company of organic peas, creamy yogurt, tangy mango chutney, and freshly chopped cilantro. Wrap it all up in your favorite Trader Joe’s tortilla, and it’s Tasty City, population: you.

Whether you fall into the meat-eater or meat-free crowd, there’s a Tikka Masala for you in the frozen case at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, ready to heat-and-eat, or add to your edible wrapper of choice.

blocks.html: When something is described as “good as gold,” you know you’re getting the very best. What if that something is “good as gold… and chocolate”? Well, friends, that’s cause for celebration! Yes! Trader Joe’s has long offered Milk Chocolate Coins of the World during the holiday season, a collection of foil-wrapped, coin-shaped chocolates featuring designs from countless countries’ currency. And this year marks the introduction of The Milk Chocolate Coin, a statement in gold foil, a currency only available at Trader Joe’s, a minor miracle in milk chocolate.

blocks.title: Two Sides of the Chocolate Coin

blocks.html: These chocolate coins—large and small—are made exclusively for Trader Joe’s by a longtime partner in the Netherlands. Through the marvel of moviemaking, we’re taking you to the room where it happens— “it” being the masterful making of these mouthwatering morsels. They’re as good as gold… and chocolate!

There is something irresistible about movie theater popcorn. As soon as you set foot in the lobby of your local multiplex, that unmistakable, buttery aroma wafts through the air, beckoning you to the snack stand.

But what if you’re craving a cinematic snacking experience without the cinema?  What if a trip to the theater isn’t in the cards or the budget? Well, if that’s the case, dim the lights and cue the music—because Trader Joe’s Movie Theater Popcorn is ready for its close-up. 

No ticket? No problem. Our gluten free Movie Theater Popcorn brings the snack stand to you...

Most bagged, buttered popcorn is air-popped and then sprayed with [often artificial] clarified butter. We, however, kettle-pop our Movie Theater Popcorn in [always real] clarified butter, just like they do at the movies. That bold, buttery taste you love gets popped into every last kernel.

Next, we spray the Popcorn with a tiny bit of expeller-pressed vegetable oil (just enough to get the salt to stick), salt it, bag it, and send it off to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, where it patiently awaits its big break... into your shopping basket. 

Reach for Movie Theater Popcorn any time you need some crunch to carry you through life’s cliffhangers. Have a few bags on hand for summer sports-spectating, impromptu movie nights, or popcorn parties. If you’re an “extra butter” person, try pouring the Popcorn in a bowl and drizzling it with warm TJ’s Clarified Butter on top for a hot, fresh-from-the-popper experience.

No matter how you choose to enjoy it, Trader Joe’s Movie Theater Popcorn is sure to snag a recurring role on your shopping list.

Nowadays, a large popcorn at the movies will cost you an arm and a leg. Luckily, at Trader Joe's, value still reigns supreme—so we're selling 5-ounce bags of Movie Theater Popcorn for just $1.99 each. You'll find this everyday, blockbuster value in our snack aisle. 

Roll the credits, Joe...

blocks.html: As a varietal, Viognier may not be nearly as ubiquitous as Chardonnay or Sauvignon Blanc, but don’t let its relative rarity fool you. This crisp, floral, phenomenally fruity white wine deserves just as much attention as its more commonly-poured cousins, and our Honey Moon Viognier is a perfect example of why. Lush, refreshing, and highly versatile, Honey Moon is a genuine gem of the Trader Joe’s wine section. So come, join us, as we take a moment to properly let this Honey Moon shine.

Brought exclusively to us by a long-trusted winery partner out of California, Honey Moon Viognier’s full body and fruit-forward flavor make it a natural pairing for a wide variety of cheeses, for starters. Creamy Bries, nutty Manchegos, even big, ripe blues will all have something to play off of within this wine’s layered notes of white peach, nectarine, and guava. This elegant fruitiness also makes it a great companion for spicier fare, especially spicy foods with an element of creaminess to them, like a hot, coconut-based curry. That said, we find its splendidly botanic aromatics make it a great wine for simply sipping on its own, too.

While there’s much to be moony about regarding our Honey Moon Viognier, we’re especially fond of its value: you might expect a sky-high price for such an out-of-this-world wine, but at Trader Joe’s, you can find 750mL bottles for the rather reasonable retail of $5.99*.

blocks.html: Spring is in full bloom, and so are the big, bountiful floral values at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s! Whether you’re looking to liven up your living space or brighten someone’s day (could be your own—as the song goes, you can buy yourself flowers), we have just the Flowers & Plants to help you do it.

One of our top picks? The classic Trader Joe’s Seasonal Mixed Bouquet—it’s our hand-selected mix of bright, brilliant blooms and fresh greens, starring the ever-cheerful and always colorful Gerbera daisy. Join us as we journey up the California coast to visit one of our long-time growers, where we'll pull back the curtain—or rather, open up the greenhouse—on how these beautiful Bouquets come together.

blocks.title: Values In Bloom: From Buds to Bouquets

blocks.html: While the Bouquets' exact “recipe” may vary from season to season and region to region, one thing remains the same, all year long: you simply won’t find a better value on blooms this beautiful anywhere but your neighborhood Trader Joe's.

When a bear growls, all the creatures in the forest head for their holes—but when a bear’s tummy growls, well... you know she’s heading for her neighborhood Trader Joe’s to stock up on fall essentials for the cozy season ahead! 

Watch the video, and then visit your neighborhood Trader Joe’s to see for yourself. (And don’t hesitate to say, “Hi!” to the bear if you see her.)

Follow this bear to Trader Joe’s, where you’ll find familiar autumnal products, such as Apple Cider Foaming Hand Soap for soiled paws; Maple Brown Butter Almonds for nutty-sweet maple-flavored snacking; and Pumpkin Bisque to warm your body and satisfy those tummy growls.*

And just when your cart is struggling to bear the weight of this fabulous fall haul, you’ll still need to make some space for new seasonal products, like our Cinnamon Powdered Sugar Mini Donuts (arriving September 8th)—no surprise, they’re more than just a little good!

Your surprise will come at the register, when you realize that our shelves are not just bearing fall treats—we come bearing value. That means high-quality, delicious products to help you celebrate the season, at prices that will have you celebrating the savings.

*Some of these products are in stores now, others are coming soon!

For several years in a row, our customers (maybe even you, reading this right now) have voted Trader Joe’s Mandarin Orange Chicken their overall favorite product. And why wouldn’t it be? Tender chunks of juicy chicken in a crispy breading, coated with a house-made sauce of fresh California orange peels, fresh ginger, fresh garlic, fresh green onions, and soy sauce… Heck, even we’re drooling at the thought.

Because this product hit our shelves way back in 2004 (and because it’s your favorite), you probably know its preparation instructions by heart. And while it’s perfectly acceptable to microwave the sauce, mix it with the baked chicken and get on with your life, there’s an extra step you can take that takes this chicken over the top, and makes it extra delicious... watch the video or follow the instructions below to learn how.

It’s quite simple, really: Bake the chicken according to the package instructions. Then, during the last few minutes of cooking, pour the defrosted sauce into a HOT wok or non-stick pan—hot is the key here. Stir the cooked morsels of chicken into the sizzling sauce, and watch it transform as it clings to the chicken—perfectly caramelized, sweet and tangy. Looks like takeout, and tastes even better.

Now, on to the best part—the eating! Whether you skewer the chicken with toothpicks for a no-fuss appetizer, or plate it with rice & steamed veggies for a square meal, you’ve got a whole lot of tastiness, without a whole lot of work. Which we think is pretty great, if we do say so ourselves.

We’re selling each 22-ounce package of Trader Joe’s Mandarin Orange Chicken for the WOW price of $4.99*, everyday. You’ll find them in our freezers.
